title: cassia fasciculata var. rostrata
intro: Cassia fasciculata var. rostrata, commonly known as Sensitive Plant or Sensitive Pea, is a perennial herbaceous plant in the legume family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin problems, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cassia fasciculata var. rostrata include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it effective in treating pain, reducing inflammation, and preventing infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
